name: 18b-shop-in-pewter
objective: Walk from Pewter's Pokemon Center to its Mart and buy five Poke Balls, five Potions and five Antidotes. The bag has held nothing but the gym's own TM34 at every link of the chain so far, which is why catch::decide can only ever answer 'no ball', and why a lead poisoned on Route 3 had nothing at all to take.
evidence: map=0x38 - wCurMap $D35E. PEWTER_MART is const index 56, and Pewter City's own object data names it: map $02's warp[4] at (23,17) leads to map $38 warp[0]. Map $38 decodes as tileset 2, 8x8 blocks, with warps at (3,7) and (4,7) back to $FF - the same building as Viridian's $2A, whose object list carries the same clerk sprite (pic $26) at the same tile (0,5) facing right.

THE BAG IS NOT EMPTY AT THIS POINT AND AtlasGB's catching.md measurement stopped one link too early. On all 600 link-18 exits wNumBagItems ($D31D) reads 1 and the entry at $D31E is item $EA = TM34, which the gym hands over with the badge - EVENT_GOT_TM34 is one of the three bits in the $D755 change that link 17's own evidence records. So POKE_BALL lands in bag slot 2 ($D320/$D321) and POTION in slot 3 ($D322/$D323), and the goal names the ids as well as the counts rather than trusting the slot.

The counts are what the three things that need a bag ask for. FIVE POKE BALLS because catch::decide answers Unavailable with none, and because a Poke Ball is the best chance per yen at every catch rate and every HP - the resampling loop is worth at most 1.27x for a Great Ball and 1.70x for an Ultra against price ratios of 3x and 6x (https://github.com/Alchemy86/AtlasGB/tree/main/atlases/pokemon-rb/docs/catching.md). FIVE ANTIDOTES because POISON, not a battle, is what kills this chain past Pewter - every one of link 20's twenty failures and all seven of link 21's is a lead poisoned in a forced trainer fight and walking to death afterwards - and an antidote CURES it where a potion buys twenty HP of the same problem. FIVE POTIONS for the lead that is simply worn down.

THE ANTIDOTE LANDS IN BAG SLOT 4 BECAUSE THE BAG IS IN PURCHASE ORDER. TM34 came in with the badge, then POKE_BALL, then POTION, then ANTIDOTE - so the id is at $D324 and the count at $D325, and the goal names the id as well as the count rather than trusting the slot. The stock row is 3, from Pewter's own list order, and the price is 100 read out of ItemPrices at file offset 0x4608 (three-byte BCD per item, item ids one-based) - against a POTION's 300.

The prices are read out of the cartridge rather than typed in: ItemPrices at file offset 0x4608 puts a POKE BALL at 200 and a POTION at 300, and the mart tables at 0x02442 give Pewter's stock as POKE_BALL, POTION, ESCAPE_ROPE, ANTIDOTE, BURN_HEAL, AWAKENING, PARLYZ_HEAL in that order. 2500 against the 4651 the chain carries out of the gym.

THE CLERK IS TALKED TO ACROSS A COUNTER. Map $38's tile (1,5) is $1E, one of the tileset's counter tiles, so standing at (2,5) facing left puts a counter in front of the player and Gen 1 looks one tile further for the sprite - which is the clerk at (0,5). Standing anywhere adjacent to the clerk himself is impossible: (1,5) is the counter and (0,4)/(0,6) are wall.
